title: Arkansas methods, deer zones, and WMA rules

methods.label: Archery / crossbow
methods.summary: Early buck-only Aug 29–31; general archery Sept 26–Feb 28 on private land and many public areas.

methods.label: Alternative firearms
methods.summary: Formerly muzzleloader — Oct 17–25 plus December splits by zone; closed in zones 4 and 5.

methods.label: Modern gun
methods.summary: Opens Nov 14; end date depends on deer zone. Christmas holiday hunt Dec 26–28 statewide.

methods.label: Shotgun
methods.summary: Turkey, dove, small game, and waterfowl as listed.

prohibited: Hunting a WMA without the required WMA permit when one is listed for that season.
Using dogs for deer where the zone or WMA prohibits dogs.
Hunting outside zone or WMA dates.
unitRules: Private-land deer zones and WMA/NWR zones are separate — each WMA is its own zone in the guidebook.
Christmas holiday modern gun Dec 26–28 is statewide unless a WMA closes it.
Youth modern gun hunts Nov 7–8 and Jan 2–3 — check WMA exceptions.
